name: P-006 isolated Codex pinned instruction recovery after selected source update
command: Inside the verified disposable instance: write local domain identity v1, GET bootstrap-su/options, POST bootstrap-su with selected_identity_revision, change the fixture to v2, remove that session's AGENTS.md, POST adv/sessions/ensure-codex-home, inspect restored AGENTS.md and the isolated adv_sessions row
summary: The isolated current-build operator restored the authenticated v1 Codex instructions after the selected identity source changed to v2. It reported a pinned-source-stale recovery and kept the original selected source and specification revision in the launch record. The verifier tore down its disposable database and home after exit 0.

assertions.evidence: The verifier confirmed sidecar HARNESS_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL reached its disposable Postgres on port 42149, workspace verify-tauri-isolated-90, and the frozen plain-node host bundle contained pinned-source-stale. No shared database or user Codex home was modified.
Native bootstrap-su returned status ok and sessionId 1 for domain:p006-native-domain v1. Its specificationRevision was 1354e5bfa082c18a1cc855aceefc264ece96890ca975747954193b97e1a69f95.

After editing only the isolated identity source and prompt to v2 and removing only this test session's AGENTS.md, native ensure-codex-home returned ok=true, repaired=true, promptRepaired=true, reason=pinned-source-stale, preservedSpecificationRevision=1354e5bfa082c18a1cc855aceefc264ece96890ca975747954193b97e1a69f95. The restored AGENTS.md contained NATIVE P006 V1 DEFINITION and lacked NATIVE P006 V2 DEFINITION.

The isolated adv_sessions row retained selectedIdentity.ref=domain:p006-native-domain, sourceRevision=9dbb796f4e02f9a562bc2610ce850caddb7cdc4160affa691d285e82d58579f0, and specificationRevision=1354e5bfa082c18a1cc855aceefc264ece96890ca975747954193b97e1a69f95.

operatorPlane: current-build frozen host and isolated Tauri/Postgres
limitation: This exercised the native bootstrap and missing-home recovery endpoints and persisted receipt, but did not start or resume an actual Codex model turn. It did not test warm Claude carry, fresh operational producer values, fleet/GOAL replacement, or generic identity isolation.
